string-array.name: sensitivity_explain
string-array.item: Blocks only near-certain spam (score 90+). Likely spam (60+) rings silently.
Blocks likely spam (score 70+), such as ARCEP telemarketing ranges. Doubtful calls (40+) ring silently.
Blocks from score 50, silences from 25. Best if you rarely get calls from unknown numbers.

resources.string: Senior protection is on: chut is strict, and unknown numbers ring silently.
Blocked from install, no learning needed. By law, telemarketers in France must call from 01 62, 01 63, 02 70, 02 71, 03 77, 03 78, 04 24, 04 25, 05 68, 05 69, 09 48 and 09 49.
For all other numbers. Once you have blocked 5 numbers, chut trains itself on the phone and recognises numbers that look like them. Nothing to do.
A silenced number that calls back within 5 minutes rings. Blocked numbers never do.

chut checks if a number is in your contacts, on the phone. It never reads names.
Strict filtering, and every number that is not a contact rings silently with a notification. Ideal for a parent\'s phone: scammers target them first.
A silent notification with Block and Not spam buttons.
Off by default: blocked calls just disappear.
The statistics start over. Your lists are kept.
No account, no ads, no trackers, no internet access. Your lists, history and model never leave this phone.

Android asks chut about every incoming call, before it rings, even when the app is closed. chut answers on the phone, in a fraction of a millisecond, without the internet.

1. Your lists first. Your allow list and your contacts always ring. Your block list, if you keep one, never does. It is optional: block a number when it bothers you, or import your phone's list.

2. ARCEP ranges: since 2023, telemarketers must call from 12 known ranges (01 62, 09 48…). They count for 70 points.

3. The learned model. chut trains a logistic regression on the phone from what you block: blocks of numbers (4 to 9 digits) and call hours. It compares your blocked numbers with 3,000 random French numbers and with the ones you let ring. One block doesn't make its neighbours suspicious; several in the same block of 1,000 numbers do. Its probability becomes points, up to 95.

4. Points combine into a score from 0 to 100, and your sensitivity decides: ring, ring silently with a notification, or block.

Every decision keeps its reasons: tap a call to see why. Block or Not spam retrains the model at once.
Calls chut let ring without sound
